content.text: Resolving: keep both new dashboards (beszel from master, tempmail from the PR), appended in chronological order.

arguments.command:
cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && python3 - <<'EOF'
import re, io

# README.md / README.zh-CN.md: keep both rows, master (beszel) first, then PR (tempmail)
for path, tm, bz in [
    ("README.md",
     "| [`tempmail`](https://awesome.metrix.bar/dashboards/tempmail)               | Temporary email inbox             |",
     "| [`beszel`](https://awesome.metrix.bar/dashboards/beszel)                   | Beszel server monitoring          |"),
    ("README.zh-CN.md",
     "| [`tempmail`](https://awesome.metrix.bar/dashboards/tempmail)               | 临时邮箱与验证码        |",
     "| [`beszel`](https://awesome.metrix.bar/dashboards/beszel)                   | Beszel 服务器监控       |"),
]:
    s = open(path, encoding="utf-8").read()
    pat = re.compile(r"<<<<<<< HEAD\n(.*?)=======\n(.*?)>>>>>>> origin/master\n", re.S)
    m = pat.search(s)
    assert m and m.group(1) == tm + "\n" and m.group(2) == bz + "\n", path
    s = s[:m.start()] + bz + "\n" + tm + "\n" + s[m.end():]
    open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8").write(s)

path = "registry/sources.json"
s = open(path, encoding="utf-8").read()
pat = re.compile(r"<<<<<<< HEAD\n(.*?)=======\n(.*?)>>>>>>> origin/master\n", re.S)
ms = list(pat.finditer(s))
assert len(ms) == 2
head_id, master_id = ms[0].group(1), ms[0].group(2)
head_rel, master_rel = ms[1].group(1), ms[1].group(2)
# both fragments must be the field blocks for the two new entries
assert head_id.splitlines()[0].strip() == '"id": "tempmail",'
assert master_id.splitlines()[0].strip() == '"id": "beszel",'

tail = '''      "author": "miantiao-me",
      "license": "Apache-2.0",
      "releases": [
        {
'''
# Rebuild whole tail from the second conflict: the remaining literal text after it
after = s[ms[1].end():]
assert after == "        }\n      ]\n    }\n  ]\n}\n", repr(after)

def entry(idblock, relblock):
    return ("    {\n" + idblock + tail + relblock + "        }\n      ]\n    }")

new = (entry(master_id, master_rel) + ",\n" + entry(head_id, head_rel) + "\n  ]\n}\n")
# keep everything before the opening "    {\n" that preceded the first conflict
start = ms[0].start()
prefix = s[:start]
assert prefix.endswith("    {\n"), repr(prefix[-20:])
prefix = prefix[:-len("    {\n")]
s = prefix + new
open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8").write(s)
print("done")
EOF
grep -c '<<<<<<<\|>>>>>>>\|=======' README.md README.zh-CN.md registry/sources.json; echo "=== tail"; tail -30 registry/sources.json
